detailedSections.heading: Visual No-Code Builder
detailedSections.description: Empower business users to build sophisticated AI workflows without writing a single line of code. Drag, drop, and deploy.

features.title: Drag-and-Drop Canvas
features.description: Build AI workflows visually by connecting agents, tools, and integrations with visual blocks. Real-time preview of agent behavior with instant validation and error detection.

features.title: 75+ Pre-Built Templates
features.description: Industry-specific workflow templates for HR, Finance, and Operations. Use case accelerators for Document Processing, Customer Service, and Analytics with customizable starting points.

features.title: Business User Empowerment
features.description: Enable non-technical teams to build AI solutions with role-based access controls for safe experimentation. Approval workflows for production deployment with training programs available.

detailedSections.heading: Comprehensive SDKs
detailedSections.description: Full-featured SDKs for professional developers. Write custom logic, extend platform capabilities, and integrate with your existing tech stack.

features.title: Multi-Language Support
features.description: Python SDK for ML/AI developers with full-featured capabilities. JavaScript SDK for browser and Node.js. REST APIs for language-agnostic integration with complete documentation.

features.title: Custom Function Development
features.description: Write custom logic in Python or JavaScript that executes within agent workflows seamlessly. Access platform services and data. Package and reuse across multiple agents.

features.title: Open Standards & Extensibility
features.description: Agent Protocol for multi-agent communication. Standard interfaces for tools and memory. Plugin architecture for extending capabilities with community-contributed extensions.

detailedSections.heading: Integrated Testing & Debugging
detailedSections.description: Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize AI agents across their entire lifecycle. Built-in tools for testing, debugging, and performance analysis.

features.title: End-to-End Agent Tracing
features.description: View complete execution flow from input to output. Track agent decisions and tool usage. Identify bottlenecks and failures quickly with performance metrics at every step.

features.title: Interactive Debugging
features.description: Set breakpoints in visual workflows and inspect variables with agent state visibility. Step through execution logic with hot-reload for rapid iteration.

features.title: Automated Testing Framework
features.description: Create test scenarios for agent behaviors with regression testing for production changes. Load testing for scale validation and CI/CD pipeline integration.

detailedSections.heading: Deployment & Lifecycle Management
detailedSections.description: Deploy instantly with confidence. Built-in version control, automated rollback, and comprehensive monitoring for production AI agents.

features.title: One-Click Deployment
features.description: Deploy from development to production instantly with environment-specific configurations. Blue-green deployment for zero downtime with automatic scaling based on load.

features.title: Version Control & Rollback
features.description: Git integration for workflow versioning. Compare versions side-by-side with instant rollback to previous versions. Complete audit trail of all changes.

features.title: Lifecycle Monitoring
features.description: Real-time performance dashboards with usage analytics and cost tracking. Automated alerts for issues with health checks and uptime monitoring.

governanceItems.title: Secure by Design
governanceItems.description: Sandboxed environments with automatic security scanning

governanceItems.title: Quality Gates
governanceItems.description: Mandatory testing with performance benchmarks enforced

governanceItems.title: Best Practices Enforced
governanceItems.description: Linting, code standards, and documentation requirements
